data.answer: Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys in addition to passwords.
Severity 1 (P1) incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes.
When a breach involving customer data is confirmed, affected customers are notified within 72 hours.
A written postmortem is completed within 5 business days of closing any P1 or P2 incident.
The incident response plan is exercised through a tabletop drill twice a year.
All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256, covering databases, object storage, backups and laptop disks.
All connections to Nimbus Ledger Sync use TLS 1.2 or higher, with TLS 1.3 preferred and negotiated whenever supported.
Encryption keys are created and stored in AWS KMS and are rotated every 365 days. Access to key administration is limited to two named engineers and is logged.
Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 1 hour (at most one hour of data can be lost), and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 4 hours (service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster).
Production runs in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) with a cross-region disaster recovery replica maintained in Singapore (ap-southeast-1).
